output_dir.description: every file goes here; pretrain.yaml's dataset_dir points here

fasta.description: swissprot, trembl, uniref50, uniref90, uniref100, a URL, or a local .fasta/.fa (.gz/.zst)

weight.description: Share of training sequences (not tokens) drawn from this source. Weights must sum to 1 (within 1e-6); with one source it is 1 or left out. The weights also share out the validation split, so changing them redraws it: a plain source splits and tokenizes again, a cluster source rebuilds only its index. A cluster source counts one sample per cluster visit.

prepared.description: A folder another data.yaml built, used as it is. Set fasta or prepared, not both. A prepared source takes no data_params overrides and no cluster_subsampling.

members.description: The sequences training draws from: uniref90, uniref100, or a UniRef90/100 FASTA URL/path. Leave it out to use this source's fasta.

clusters.description: Where the clusters come from. auto: UniProt's clusters for UniRef data, else CL:<cluster id> tags in the FASTA headers, else MMseqs2 (up to 20 GB of FASTA; above that, set mmseqs2). Or mmseqs2, uniprot, headers, or a .tsv / .tsv.gz / .tsv.zst file of representative<TAB>member lines (a path or a URL). Called clustering before.

identity.description: mmseqs2 only: min sequence identity within a cluster

cluster_subsampling.description: Turns on cluster subsampling for this source: each epoch trains on one random member of every cluster. true turns it on and finds the clusters from the data; a mapping sets the fields below. false, or no key, turns it off. max_seqs and val_ratio then count clusters, not sequences.

sources.description: One entry per source, keyed by a name you pick (letters, digits and _). Each names a fasta to build from or a prepared folder. Any data_params field but val_ratio / val_size set on a source overrides the default for that source. Several sources make a mix: each is built on its own and training draws from them by weight.

val_ratio.description: share of the mix held out for validation

drop_invalid_sequences.description: true: drop sequences with unknown residues instead of stopping

val_size.description: A fixed number of validation sequences (clusters, for a cluster source) for the whole mix, instead of val_ratio. Set only one of the two. In a mix it is shared out by the source weights.

shuffle.description: shuffle before the train / val split

samples_per_shard.description: sequences per shard file; raised automatically for large cluster datasets

max_workers.description: tokenizer processes and MMseqs2 threads; -1 = all cores
